# Code of conduct

Tellerwerk is for anyone who wants to keep track of what they eat, in whatever body they have and whatever their goal is. Contributors keep the same spirit in issues, pull requests and anywhere else the project meets people.

## Expected

- Be kind and patient. Many people here aren't developers, and many write in their second language. English and German are both fine.
- Assume good intent, and critique ideas, not people.
- Keep questions about food and bodies factual and free of judgement. Don't comment on anyone's weight, shape or eating, and don't give medical advice.
- Respect privacy. Never post someone else's personal data, and remind people kindly if they post their own.

## Not accepted

- Harassment, insults, or discriminatory jokes or remarks of any kind.
- Body shaming, and pushing extreme diets or disordered eating.
- Sexual language or images.
- Spam, advertising, and posting other people's private information.

## What happens

The maintainer may edit, hide or remove comments, close issues and pull requests, and block people from the project when they break these rules. Minor cases get a friendly note first.

## Reporting

Use GitHub's *Report content* menu (the "…" on any comment), or contact the maintainer privately through the profile of the [uivox](https://github.com/uivox) account. Reports are handled confidentially.

This code is inspired by the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
